Traben-Trarbach is a Moselle River cruise port and town in Germany's Rhineland-Palatinate state (Bernkastel-Wittlich district) with population around 6,000. The town is located approx 40 km (25 mi) northeast of Trier and approx 60 km (40 mi) southwest of Koblenz. The international Frankfurt-Hahn Airport is approx 10 km (6 mi) to the east.

The current-day town includes two former small towns - Traben (on the river's left bank) and Trarbach (on Moselle's right bank). The local economy is heavily based on viticulture (winegrowing) and tourism.

As cruise port, aa is included in the regular schedules of some of Europe's largest river cruise companies - like Phoenix Reisen, Scylla, Niko Tours (Mystic Cruises), Riviera Travel, Fred Olsen.

The next table shows a 9-day Phoenix Reisen cruisetour itinerary operated by the riverboat Rhein Prinzessin. Prices started from ~USD 1350 pp (double-occupancy cabin rates).
